snippet.title: BrokenLore: Don't Lie Announcement Trailer | Horror Game Awards HALLOWEEN SHOWCASE TRAILER 2025
snippet.description:
From the BrokenLore saga comes a new first-person psychological horror.
A longer and darker spin-off of DON’T WATCH.

In BrokenLore: DON’T LIE, step into the fragile world of Junko, a young woman attempting to reconnect with Shinji and Hideo, two patients she once met in a rehabilitation center. Confined to her small apartment, she struggles between daily calls, fleeting moments of intimacy, and her own destructive compulsions. Her reliance on medication slowly unravels reality itself, leading her into warped visions and liminal spaces where nothing remains stable.

STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3886200/BrokenLore_DONT_LIE/

 #thehorrorgameawards  #HorrorGamesShowcase
---
The Horror Game Awards started towards the end of 2022 as a Horror Game of the Year Award set up by two die hard horror game fans. Fourteen content creators made up that year’s jury. It was such a success that in 2023 the jury doubled in size and the awards expanded their scope.

The aim of the awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
